subject: Technical handoff and demo readouts — scheduling deep dive
messages:
From: Alex Chung <alex.chung@storium.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 Nov 2025 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro / discovery — next steps

Vivek —

Thanks again for the call this morning. The team and I appreciated the quick demo and the conversation around inference economics. Storium is interested in a technical deep dive so our ML and infra folks can validate performance characteristics and deployment options.

Attendees from our side likely: Alex Chung (CTO), Maya Singh (Lead ML), Jordan Reed (Infra). We want 60–90 minutes — ideally including a brief 10–15 minute preface on production SLAs and then hands-on architecture discussion + Q&A.

Proposed windows next week (PST):
- Thu 11/13 16:00–17:15
- Fri 11/14 09:00–10:30

Could you share who would attend from Redwood and a rough agenda? Also, can you send a SOC 2 / security summary and any pre-read on expected infra sizing so our infra lead can triage pre-call?

Thanks — Alex
Alex Chung
CTO, Storium AI
alex.chung@storium.ai

Attachment: storium_requirements.csv (summary stub)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chung <alex.chung@storium.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 Nov 2025 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro / discovery — next steps

Alex —

Appreciate the fast follow-up. We can definitely run a 60–90 minute technical handoff that covers SLAs, deployment options (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private), and a focused session on serving/runtime tradeoffs. From Redwood we will bring:
- Vivek Kulkarni — Account lead (me)
- Priya Natarajan — Solutions engineering (infra + orchestration)
- Ben Carter — ML serving specialist (quantization, batching)

Draft agenda (75 min):
1) 10 min — objectives and SLA priorities (Vivek)
2) 25 min — architecture / deployment patterns and routing + cache behavior (Priya)
3) 25 min — serving internals: batching, quantization, perf tuning (Ben)
4) 15 min — open Q&A and next steps

Availability: Thu 11/13 16:00–17:15 PST works for us. I can also do Fri 11/14 09:00–10:30 but prefer Thu to keep momentum.

I will send a calendar invite once you confirm. I’m attaching a short agenda draft and our SOC2 summary for Jordan to review. If there are specific logs/eval pre-reads you want, flag them and we’ll prep.

Best,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachments: tdx-agenda-v1.pdf, storium_soc2_summary.pdf
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chung <alex.chung@storium.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro / discovery — next steps

Alex —

Looping in Ben (ML serving) to confirm content. Quick notes on what we plan to cover and what would be helpful from your side before the call:

Planned meeting objectives:
- Confirm latency and throughput SLOs for the main inference surface
- Walk through deployment topology options (dedicated pools, private VPC, hybrid routing)
- Show how caching and continuous batching reduce token unit cost in real-world patterns
- Identify any compliance/readout needs for procurement and onboarding

Pre-read requests (if possible):
- A small sample of request size / concurrency expectations (or a representative trace)
- Any current infra constraints or preferred cloud regions

I’ve attached a slightly expanded agenda (tdx-agenda-v1.pdf) with time allocations. Ben will lead the serving optimizations portion and can run a brief live perf slide showing quantized vs FP16 paths — nothing heavy, just a couple of data points to set expectations.

If Thu 11/13 16:00–17:15 PST is good, Vivek can send the invite and we’ll include a join link and runbook.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Sr Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
